description: CanElevation - LiDAR Point Clouds is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "urban, floods", published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada. The LiDAR Point Clouds. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tags urban, floods and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: The dataset is updated as new LiDAR data becomes available. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is stated as "The LiDAR Point Clouds dataset is available free of charge under the Open Government License - Canada" on the registry page. Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
